description.ja: 『ドラゴンボールZ』より悟空の父親バーダックがプラモデル化！
description.en: Goku's father Bardock from "Dragon Ball Z" is now a plastic model!

description.ja: • 頬の十字傷や険しい表情など、バーダックのもつ魅力を細部まで再現。
description.en: • The charm of Bardock is recreated in every detail, including the cross scar on his cheek and his rugged expression.

description.ja: • 筋肉パーツを造形と分割で再現するマッスルビルドシステム搭載！
description.en: • Equipped with a muscle build system that reproduces muscle parts by modeling and dividing!

description.ja: • 高い可動域と付属のエフェクトパーツにより、名シーンや必殺技ポーズなどを再現できる。
description.en: • High range of motion and included effect parts allow you to recreate famous scenes and special move poses.

description.ja: • クリアパーツを使用したエフェクトは、放出状態と溜め状態を再現。
description.en: • Effects using clear parts reproduce the release and storage states.

description.ja: • 表情パーツは「通常」と「叫び」の２種付属。
description.en: • Two types of facial expression parts are included: "normal " and " screaming".

description.ja: • ハンドパーツは左右とも握りと開手の２種ずつ付属！
description.en: • Two types of hand parts are included: grip and open hand for both left and right hands!

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ 左手×2種 右手×2種
accessories.en: Hand parts Left hand x 2 types Right hand x 2 types

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト×2（気弾溜め、放出）
accessories.en: Special move effect x 2 (Ki bullet storage, release)

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト用台座×1
